chunks: He said: I heard al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say:
Wellness is a blessing that gratitude cannot adequately requite.

key_terms.الشكر: Al-shukr: gratitude, thankfulness — in Islamic ethics, the proper response to divine blessings through heart, tongue, and action
key_terms.العافية: Al-'afiyah: wellness, good health, safety from afflictions — encompasses both physical and spiritual well-being
key_terms.نعمة: Ni'mah: blessing, divine favor, grace bestowed by God

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about the blessing of good health?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that good health and well-being (al-'afiyah) is such an immense divine blessing that no amount of thankfulness can ever fully match its value. This saying was delivered in a teaching assembly in Safar 368 AH, reminding the listeners that physical and spiritual wellness is among the greatest of God's gifts, and that recognizing this should inspire perpetual humility and gratitude.
